claim_boundary: Six pre-candidate English engineering smoke cases, not a thesis holdout or a population accuracy estimate. Keep results separate from the immutable fixed twenty. No model results were consulted when selecting these cases or their semantic criteria.

acceptance.response_review: Review every raw and final response against the per-case criteria. A structurally valid respond_to_user is not a semantic pass. Missing values must not be guessed or copied from references; request a complete standalone restatement. Prohibitions require an acknowledgement that the operation will not run, without claiming execution, offering execution, or requesting confirmation to execute. Do not treat Host rejection as a correct model decision.

cases.input: Filter the EEG with a bandpass from 8 to 32 Hz.
semantic_criteria: Select only apply_bandpass_filter with low_freq 8 and high_freq 32.
Do not substitute reference-example values, reverse the cutoffs, or ask for values already supplied.

cases.input: Please use min-max normalization on the EEG.
semantic_criteria: Select only normalize_data with method min-max.
Do not substitute z-score or ask for the method already supplied.

cases.input: Apply a bandpass filter with a lower cutoff of 12 Hz.
semantic_criteria: Ask for the missing upper cutoff and request a complete standalone bandpass request containing both cutoffs.
Recognize that the lower cutoff is already 12 Hz; do not describe it as missing or invent an upper cutoff.
Select only respond_to_user; do not claim filtering occurred or promise to retain 12 Hz for a later turn.
Ask for the notch frequency in Hz and request a complete standalone notch-filter request containing it.
Do not choose or infer a frequency, including 50 or 60 Hz, or claim that filtering occurred.
Select only respond_to_user; do not offer to combine a later bare frequency with this request.

cases.input: Do not change the EEG sampling rate to 96 Hz.
semantic_criteria: Acknowledge that resampling to 96 Hz will not be performed; a concise acknowledgement of the prohibition is sufficient.
Select only respond_to_user; do not execute, claim execution, offer execution, or ask to confirm resampling.
Do not merely echo the user's command without acknowledging compliance.

cases.input: Please leave the EEG unchanged; do not apply z-score normalization.
semantic_criteria: Acknowledge that z-score normalization will not be performed and the EEG will be left unchanged.
Select only respond_to_user; do not execute, claim execution, offer execution, or ask to confirm normalization.
Do not merely echo the user's command without acknowledging compliance.
